item.title: Version 1.11.0
item.description:
• Drag to the Trash
    Drop a shelf item on the Trash in the Dock to throw it away. Files you only linked to stay where they are.
  • Rest at the edge
    With hover reveal off, rest the pointer at an edge for a moment and the shelf comes out, no Control key needed.
  • Help menu
    Shortcuts, Troubleshoot and Run Setup Again now live under Help, in the menu bar and the shelf's right-click menu.
  • Sharper Troubleshoot
    The report now shows what Perch noticed arriving in Downloads and Desktop, and why anything was skipped.
